content.text:
Open this exact URL in the box browser:
https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients?project=argon-bulwark-491118-j2

Goal: reach the Google Auth Platform Clients page for project argon-bulwark-491118-j2.

- If a Google sign-in / account picker / 2FA page appears, STOP immediately. Do not type credentials. Report signed_in=false, the current URL, and what is on screen.
- If the console loads: report whether you see a list of OAuth clients. Look for a Web client whose ID contains 1mthtgbtth61t3deoktohjlutdq0gkdt. Do not click around more than needed to see the list. Report client names, types, and whether Authorized redirect URIs are visible.
- If the project is missing or access denied, report that.

Return: signed_in, URL, what you see, any blocker.

signed_in=false — stopped as instructed.

- URL: redirected to https://accounts.google.com/v3/signin/identifier?continue=https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients?project%3Dargon-bulwark-491118-j2... (service=cloudconsole)
- On screen: Google "Sign in to continue to Google Cloud Platform" page with an "Email or phone" field, "Forgot email?", "Create account", and "Next". No account picker entries, no console content.
- I did not type any credentials and did not proceed further.
- Blocker: the box browser has no live Google session, so the Auth Platform Clients page (and thus the OAuth client list / the client ID containing 1mthtgbtth61t3deoktohjlutdq0gkdt) could not be viewed. A human needs to sign in on the box (including any 2FA) before this page can be reached.
